title: Fruit Fly Potato Culture Media Preparation
author: Jorge Frias
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bei3jcgn

steps.title: Prepare base medium solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 12.9 g dried yeast, 1 g white sugar, 40 g instant mashed potato flakes, 10 g agar, and 0.875 g ascorbic acid in 1.1 L distilled water.

steps.title: Cool and add Nipagin
steps.instruction: Cool the mixture to 60 °C, then add 8.5 mL of 10 % Nipagin solution and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Mix and dispense medium
steps.instruction: Mix the medium well and fill each preferred fruit‑fly vial or bottle to about one‑quarter of its volume with the medium.

steps.title: Solidify and store medium
steps.instruction: In a clean bench hood, let the medium solidify in the open‑capped vials, then store the solidified medium at 4 °C for later use.
